sb.name: Abyssal Chicken
sb.speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (see bad flier below)
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

traits.name: Bad Flier
traits.desc: The abyssal chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abyssal chicken makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Suave Defense
traits.desc: While Amrik is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Charisma modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Amrik makes three dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Smoke Bomb (1/Day)
actions.desc: Amrik hurls a smoke bomb up to 20 feet away. The bomb explodes on impact, creating a cloud of black smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere. The area within the cloud is heavily obscured. A strong wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise remains until the end of Amrik's next turn.

sb.name: Archduke Zariel of Avernus
sb.damage_resistances: fire, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zariel's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Zariel's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 36 (8d8) fire damage (included in the weapon attacks below).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zariel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Zariel regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Zariel dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Zariel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 26). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]] (can become Medium when changing her appearance), [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blade Barrier|blade barrier]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zariel attacks twice with her flail and once with Matalotok. She can substitute Horrid Touch for Matalotok.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Matalotok (Warhammer)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning, or 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 36 (8d8) fire damage. In addition, the weapon emits a burst of cold that deals 10 (3d6) cold damage to each creature within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Horrid Touch (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Zariel touches one creature within 10 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is also blinded and deafened. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Zariel magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

legendary_actions.name: Immolating Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Zariel turns her magical gaze toward one creature she can see within 120 feet of her and commands it to combust. The target must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Arkhan the Cruel
sb.damage_resistances: fire, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft. (can see invisible creatures out to the same range), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Aura of Hate
traits.desc: While Arkhan isn't incapacitated, he and all fiends and undead within 30 feet of him deal 4 extra damage whenever they hit with a melee weapon attack (already factored into Arkhan's attacks). This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage type.

traits.name: Hand of Vecna
traits.desc: The Hand of Vecna has 8 charges and regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. Arkhan can cast the following spells from the hand by expending the specified number of charges (spell save DC 18): [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|finger of death]] (5 charges), [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|sleep]] (1 charge), [[Tools/Spells/Slow|slow]] (2 charges), and [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]] (3 charges).

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Arkhan wields Fane-Eater and wears a suit of Obsidian Flint Dragon Plate. The armor gives Arkhan advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the grappled condition on him.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Arkhan's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). He can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|animate dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]] (at 4th level), [[Tools/Spells/Revivify|revivify]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Geas|geas]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Arkhan makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Fane-Eater (Battleaxe)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (1d8 + 12) slashing damage, or 17 (1d10 + 12) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. If the target is a creature and Arkhan rolls a 20 on the attack roll, the creature takes an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and Arkhan regains an amount of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, plus 4 piercing damage and 9 (2d8) cold damage if the javelin was used to make a melee attack.

sb.name: Bel
sb.damage_resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to Bel that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw, unless Bel is incapacitated. Unless the save succeeds, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Bel's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Bel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Bel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Bel's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Bel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23). Bel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|mislead]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Imprisonment|imprisonment]], [[Tools/Spells/Meteor Swarm|meteor swarm]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Bel makes three attacks: two with his greatsword and one with his tail.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that is not being held or worn, it catches fire.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Tactical Edge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Roll a d6 for Bel. The number rolled on the die is subtracted from the next attack roll made against Bel or an ally of his choice within the next minute.

legendary_actions.name: Summon Ice Devil (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Bel magically summons an ice devil with an ice spear (as described in the ice devil's entry in the Monster Manual). The ice devil appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Bel, acts as Bel's ally, and can summon other devils if it has such power. The ice devil remains until Bel dies or until he dismisses it as an action.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Bitter Breath's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Bitter Breath makes three melee attacks: two with its fork and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

actions.name: Fork
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 10 (3d6) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time Bitter Breath hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

traits.name: Aura of Terror
traits.desc: When a hostile creature within 5 feet of the black gauntlet makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it has disadvantage on the roll. Creatures that are immune to the frightened condition are immune to this trait.

traits.name: Tactical Discipline
traits.desc: The black gauntlet has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The black gauntlet is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bane|bane]], [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Guiding Bolt|guiding bolt]] (see "Actions" below)
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Silence|silence]]
- **3rd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Sending|sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The black gauntlet makes two attacks with its mace.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Guiding Bolt (1st-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of the black gauntlet's next turn has advantage. If the black gauntlet casts this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.desc: The bone whelk can cause Medium or smaller objects to adhere to it. A Medium or smaller creature that touches the bone whelk is grappled by it (escape DC 10).

traits.name: Death Scream
traits.desc: When the bone whelk dies, it emits a blood-curdling shriek than can be heard out to a range of 120 feet. This shriek causes nonmagical, organic material within 10 feet of the bone whelk to rot. Each creature within 10 feet of the bone whelk when it dies takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The bone whelk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

sb.name: Burney the Barber
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 27

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Burney fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Healer
traits.desc: Burney has the benefits of the healer feat as well as proficiency with both the healer's kit and the herbalism kit.

traits.name: Bahamut's Blessings
traits.desc: Burney has received several blessings in her service to Bahamut: • Unless Burney decided otherwise, once any creature less powerful than a deity has taken three steps from her, they can no longer remember her or having interacted with her specifically. • Burney is under the effect of a permanent [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]] spell, and cannot be detected by magical or mundane means unless she wishes it. In exchange for this blessing, Burney can take no direct action against the denizens of the Nine Hells, though she can certainly enlist the help of those who can. • Burney always knows the location of the Wandering Emporium and can transport herself there as though by a [[Tools/Spells/Word Of Recall|word of recall]] spell. This explains why Burney simply seems to appear amid the fully deployed marketplace each morning it is active to provide service and tell stories. • Once each day, when Burney so desires, she can instantly transport herself to the court of Bahamut via a powerful blessing akin to the [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Burney can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Burney's choice that is within 120 feet of Burney and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Burney's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc:
Burney uses one of the following breath weapons.

- **Acid Breath.** Burney exhales acid in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (14d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- **Slowing Breath.** Burney exhales gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Burney magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Burney's choice). In a new form, Burney retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Burney beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Burney must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Burney can then fly up to half its flying speed.

traits.name: Secure Memory
traits.desc: Crokek'toeck is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: Crokek'toeck's long jump is up to 60 feet and its high jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Aura of Murder
traits.desc: As long as the death's head is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The death's head has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The death's head uses Stunning Gaze and makes two dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger

actions.name: Stunning Gaze
actions.desc: The death's head targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Unstoppable (3/Day)
reactions.desc: The death's head reduces the damage it takes from an attack to 0.

sb.name: Dryad Spirit
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.desc: The dryad can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away that aren't undead or constructs. She knows the general direction they're in but not their exact locations.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The dryad can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the dryad that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the dryad is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the dryad's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Wail (1/Day)
actions.desc: The dryad releases a mournful wail, provided that she isn't in sunlight. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet of her that can hear her must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

sb.name: Duke Thalamra Vanthampur
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft. (see devil's sight below), passive Perception 13

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: Thalamra has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Thalamra can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, out to a distance of 120 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Hellish Rebuke (1st-Level Spell; 2/Day)
reactions.desc: When Thalamra is damaged by a creature within 60 feet of her that she can see, the creature that damaged her is engulfed in hellish flames and must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
